_comment: Custom sub-sector indices, equal-weight and chain-linked from the daily scans by tools/build_indices.py (run by the daily pull; output data/indices/series.json, read by the Indices page). Add one: python tools/build_indices.py add --id cnc --name 'CNC Machines' --codes JYOTICNC,MACPOWER,LMW -- or edit this file. Codes are NSE codes exactly as they appear in data/scans/. Remove a name by deleting it; the series rebuilds from history on the next run.

indices.name: AI Data Centre
indices.note: The build-out chain for AI compute in India: optical fibre, power systems, servers, GPU cloud, networking, DC real estate and EPC.

indices.name: CDMO
indices.note: Contract development and manufacturing: the outsourcing leaders and the smaller API/intermediate CDMOs riding the same demand.

indices.name: Pharma Mid & Small
indices.note: Mid and small-cap pharma with a live trigger — IOL and SMS on the ibuprofen shortage — plus the strongest-RS names in the group.

indices.name: Pipes
indices.note: Line pipes, stainless and structural tubes: the export and pipeline capex cycle.

indices.name: Specialty Chem — Dyes
indices.note: Dye intermediates and pigments: H-acid, K-acid and vinyl sulphone tightness out of China.

indices.name: Aerospace & Defence
indices.note: Aircraft, missiles, defence electronics, aero structures and explosives. Shipyards sit in their own tracker.

indices.name: Optical Fibre & Telecom Gear
indices.note: Optical fibre and cable makers and telecom equipment: the passive and active layer of fibre roll-outs and data-centre interconnect.

indices.name: EMS & Electronics
indices.note: Contract electronics manufacturers: consumer, industrial, automotive and aerospace boards and box builds.

indices.name: Power T&D & Transformers
indices.note: Transformers, switchgear, conductors and the contractors who build transmission lines.

indices.name: Shipbuilding & Marine
indices.note: Shipyards, ship owners, marine services and marine electricals.
